# Este in Turkey

> Medical tourism clinic in Istanbul offering hair transplantation (FUE Sapphire, DHI Choi), dental treatments (implants, crowns, veneers, whitening), and aesthetic procedures. Multilingual site (EN/RU/DE/RO) with verified Google reviews.

## Services

- [Hair Transplantation](https://esteinturkey.com/hair-transplantation/): FUE, DHI Choi, Sapphire techniques, beard and eyebrow transplants
- [Dental Treatments](https://esteinturkey.com/stomatologiya/): Implants, crowns, veneers, whitening
- [Aesthetic Procedures](https://esteinturkey.com/lechenie/): Skin, hair and dental aesthetics
- [Before and After Gallery](https://esteinturkey.com/do-posle-peresadka-volos/): Real patient results with photos
- [Pricing](https://esteinturkey.com/ceny-peresadka-volos/): Transparent price lists
